original_test_intent: Verify OAM_6 sensor readings and health states are complete, correct and consistent across Redfish, IPMI, ROCm and BMC Web.
original_method: Map OAM_6 readings and discrete states across all views, capture synchronized samples, normalize units and state vocabulary, then independently evaluate value deltas, threshold/status parity and related logs.
manual_activity: Thermal owner approves OAM_6 reading/state mappings and thresholds and makes the final determination.
safety_requirements: Do not translate unknown or unavailable into healthy
Preserve status anomalies and stop on unmapped state
agent_execution_scope: Check completeness, age, value and state parity
Report without threshold manipulation or verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its OAM_6 Redfish read is relevant but insecure and cannot cover IPMI, ROCm, Web or state-semantic parity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Capture all four OAM_6 views securely and evaluate numeric readings and discrete health/threshold states as separate mapped dimensions.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OAM_6, three named tools, Web check and 5/5 minutes are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build per-sensor columns for raw reading/unit and raw state/threshold on each interface, then normalize and compare each dimension independently with timestamps.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Prevents a plausible number from masking a critical or unknown health state.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No threshold injection or thermal stimulus is introduced.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Interfaces may expose threshold assertions differently; only an approved semantic map can establish equivalence.

project_override_considerations: Platform owner defines equivalent OAM_6 state vocabularies and which threshold flags each interface must expose.
expected_evidence: Logs, exception decisions, cleanup and verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master consistently specifies OAM_6 multi-source comparison; DeepSeek's partial collection does not override it.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Required project mappings and runtime prerequisites can be supplied.

review_improvement: Separates value correctness from health/threshold semantics so numeric plausibility cannot mask an OAM_6 fault state.
independent_technical_reasoning: A sensor may report an in-range number while also carrying non-OK status due to stale data, threshold latch or read failure. Conversely, IPMI threshold flags and Redfish Health are not necessarily one-to-one. OAM_6 must therefore have two comparisons—measurement and state—with unknown semantics escalated instead of flattened to healthy.
